review_description: I would recommend EcoSmart Solar to anyone thinking of installing a home solar system.The whole process from quotation to installation was carried out in a totally professional way.

I was given good advice to help me make an informed decision as to the system to best suit my needs.The chaps were punctual and consulted with me on various aspects of the installation before going ahead.The installation was very neat and tidy with all the wiring enclosed and out of sight.I was given all the relevant information to understand the operation of the system.
The sales/quoting process was excellent. The installation was great and the system is performing better than I expected..

EcoSmart Solar was very quick to organise a quote. Jeff sat down and spoke to my wife and I and gave us three options at three different price points and his overall recommendation.We decided to go with a slightly more expensive system to get a more premium inverter (SMA). We were very surprised that they could install the system two weeks from the original quote, which was still in the same calendar year, which meant more STC's would be applied, making the system slightly more affordable then if it was installed a few weeks later.The team performing the install communicated with me to confirm a start time and rough installation time. There was only a short disruption to our power, when they connected the inverter to the main switchboard.The install was very tidy, and I was provided with all of the details to access the inverter via email.My only complaint which is not the fault of EcoSmart solar was, Ergon Energy forces installers to retard the system to 90% of their max capacity. Which meant instantaneous power output was only 4.5kW rather than the 5.0kW the inverter was rated for. I wish this had been communicated during the initial consultation. I was advised by EcoSmart Solar to check the daily output rather than instantaneous values.Would definitely recommend them again!
The team at eco smart are second to none,  the advice and price and the quality of the gear can't be beaten

Jeff is very knowledgeable and experienced in solar installs, we already had a 6.6 kw system and wanted to add more panels and a battery. After studying our usage history and previous bills he came up with 3 proposals for us. We ended up installing another 4kw of panels, new hybrid inverter and a 12.8kw battery. From accepting the quote to installation was only a couple of weeks and very well done. The installers were punctual, turning up when we were told they would. The job was completed on time. Grid connection was all organised and we received a comprehensive tutorial on using the system, both verbally and via electronic files.
Amazing workmanship. Quotes were self explanatory. Always responded to emails and calls. An amazing combination of REC panels and Tesla battery.

After meeting with the salesman the quote was emailed in a timely manner. The guys that installed the system were very friendly and polite. They tidied up everything and left no mess after the job was completed.

Quoting was straight forward, professional and quick.Installation was punctual with installers  being polite and leaving site exceptionally tidy.EcoSmart did all grid connection process, only  required me to sign application form which was done electronically.

The sales and quoting process was direct and no-nonsense. I wanted a good quality system and I got it.The installers were friendly and the electrician was knowledgeable. The solar panels are generating a large amount of power already despite being the height of winter.
Quick and Easy service

How was the sales/quoting process?  Excellent. Jeff contacted me after business hours because I was the only time I was available to talk to, due to work commitments.  Very grateful of his service.How did the installation go? Great.  Polite?  Yes.  Tidy?  Yes.  Punctual? Absolutely.How was the customer service? Awesome. They were very helpful and answered my questions satisfactorily.
Quick installation and no mess left behind. All electrical problems were fixed on the day
Could not fault Jeff & the Ecosmart team & very happy with the results, $ in my pocket! 8kw inverter and 10.4 kw of panels

Sales quoting - average, would only respond to questions with pro forma quotes.  No phone calls and did not answer questions asked via email.The installers were really nice people.  Just sparkies sent out to do a job.  They were polite, they were tidy.  Most of the work was to a very good quality but a few things could have been better. External Cat 6 cable unprotected and cable tied to external conduit, solid conduit bent over existing conduit rather than using flexible conduit, additions to fuse box not straight.Customer service was very average. They send you a txt telling you to call them to confirm your install date. The inverter was lost in transit, we we advised by the installers on the day of install but no communication from the office.  When we finally received a txt (not even a phone call) regarding the rescheduled appointment to install inverter they lied about the cause of the problem stating it was due to a sick staff member.  They were unaware that the installers had already told us the truth that the inverter was lost in transit. Then somehow the customer service lady was suggesting she was doing use a favour when rescheduling as if we should be grateful.

Came out gave me a quote which I thought was good told me I didn't need a bigger system which others were trying to sell us. The installation didn't start to well as the crew thought it was a tin roof apart from that everything went well except for a broken tile which they stuck back together I don't know how long that will last.The crew who did the installation were friendly and very helpful.
great quality and prompt service. Top notch brands installed for competitive price

The office and the installers kept us informed about what they were doing at all times -really professional communication. The installers were pleasant and easy to deal with. We especially appreciated that on our request they cheerfully dismounted and took away our ancient eyesore sat dish (even though it wasn't in the way of the panels). The first price given did seem to be a bit on the high side compared to the other quote and info on your website but a "special" early sign discount of $500 which eventuated took us over the line. Overall a pleasure to deal with and we are looking forward to enjoying our solar in the years to come.
Helpful, friendly staff.  Explained process as they went.  Demonstrated shut down

We were told up front about real costs, reliability and value for money/return on asset.All aspects were fully explained by the business owner/principalAfter thorough research we decided to go with a high quality product (non Chinese) so the cost was expensive but we have peace of mind that it is a very good system that will last.The installation went like clockwork and all paperwork and arrangements with Ergon were completed.They come thoroughly recommended.
Very good to deal with Jeff and the installation team were very goodSystem runs well so farImpressed with overall package

System being installed next week.  Very happy with the whole process.  Having three recommended providers to deal with rather than having to trawl through the whole process of sorting the sheep from the goats saved us a whole lot of time and stress at a time when we are dealing with some family illness issues.  Thank you!

We are very happy with our new solar. It has only been installed for one week and it is working really well and have already had a follow up call from our installer to check that we are happy and everything is going well.Of the three recommendations of installers given by you, Jeff at Ecosmart Solar was the only one that contacted us. We did acquire quotes from others but found Jeff to be be very helpful and extremely knowledgeable. Jeff gave the best advice after considering our needs.
We purchased a 6kW LG system from Ecosmart. They came out and ran us through the options. We chose the LG because they are the best. Install happened quickly. Really happy.
Bought an LG solar system. Jeff and his team where great. Really happy with the system and their service. Canâ€™t recommend them enough.
The quality of the workmanship from EcoSmart Solar was just fantastic they arrived on time and did a really good job I'm very very satisfied.

Just wanted to let you know how impressed we were with the whole system and the installation. The process on our part was completely effortless. The crew were great and did a very neat job. A credit to your company. Thanks for your advice and help. Thanks to all concerned. Regards Darrell
Bought a 5kW Lg solar system, the installer team was excellent. Really like the Lg warranty. Had no issues at all, Jeff looked after everthing. Great job - keep up the good work. Thank you

I chose fantastic as my answers because I have not had a negative experience with Jeff from Eco Smart Rockhampton and everything was done professionally.As well as the 6.5 solar system and selectronic Fronius Inverter I got a 330litre hot water system to replace my instant systemI would recommend Eco smart anyday to someone who was looking for a system

Contacted EcoSmart Rockhampton, Jeff attend and provide a quote. Efficient, turned up on time, ran through the options available and presented a comprehensive summary of the system. Choose top of the range LG 330W panels with an SMA inverter. System was installed within 3 weeks and Ergon connected it quickly. Great team doing the install - got stuck in and did a great job. Smooth hassle free service.

Dux solar hot water system 315 litre. Failed hot logic electronics at 2 years service. Rubbish product and rude dux company rep when rung about non existent warranty. Repairs cost nearly $400  Redback inverter excellent. LG resu battery 10kwh excellent although paid $10,000 for battery that i could have paid $7000 for if i had done my homework. Ecosmart solar / Platinum electrics very expensive but with excellent employees. Won't fight their suppliers to help customer. "Ring dux yourself "

We chose a 3kW panel system with a 5kW inverter to allow for expansion, e.g. batteries -- you need to update the question relating to this!We only had one problem: the boss went on holidays just after the installation was done and office staff did not check that all the paperwork had been done for a week -- so we had to wait for Ergon to finish the job and activate the system.
